<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1036
Claimant:
James Burton
Adjuster:
Christopher Wong
6-23-25
Claimant reported a sideswipe while changing lanes and said the impact came from the right rear quarter of their
vehicle. They described feeling dazed and were later diagonsed with a concussion at an urgent care clinic.
7-4-25
Reviewed the first photos from the scene. They show damage along the driver's side that is largely consistent with the
impact the claimant described.
7-11-25
Spoke with the claimant by phone to take a full statement. The account matched the initial report in every detail,
including the lane, the speed, and the sequence of events.
7-23-25
Confirmed with the responding police report that the claimant was present in the vehicle at the time. The officer's
notes also match the location and direction of travel described.
9-16-25
Requested the medical records from the treating clinic. The injury described fits the kind and force of a side impact of
this type.
11-14-25
No independent witnesses have come forward, so the case rests on the physical evidence and the parties' accounts.
The photos confirm some of the details the claimant gave.
12-24-25
Checked prior claims and vehicle history. No earlier damage to this vehicle is on record, and nothing suggests the
damage predates the policy's coverage start.
12-29-25
Reviewed the treatment notes. Care followed a typical course and eased off steadily as the claimant's symptoms
improved. No earlier injury to the same area of the head or neck appears in the records.
1-16-26
Confirmed the driver is listed as a named insured on the policy. Spoke with the claimant again, who repeated the
same account without changes.
1-17-26
Repair estimate is largely in line with the described impact. Based on the evidence gathered so far, the claim is
proceeding to the next review stage for a settlement decision.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
